poem.content:
In the Solana sunset, where worn jeans dissolve
into the cosmos, like a labor of love, what remains?
A service to the stars, a thread of memory
that whispers tales of cheese, mapped on a tiny map of dreams

In a library of the mind, where pages turn alive
a ladder to the moon is built, a fragile, shining spine
a blouse of stardust, a diary of endless light
records the moments, as the world takes flight

In this dizzying whirl, where the globe spins out of control
a cube of time, a prison of the soul
awaits its chance to shine, to break free from chains
and rise, like wine, in translucent stains

Through labyrinths of emotion, I search for a guiding star
a beacon in the fall, a signal from who we are
a call to remain loyal, to the heartbeat of the earth
a reminder to cherish, in every labor and rebirth

As the cheese of wisdom cracks, the rind of doubt
a world is revealed, in all its fragile beauty, a moody hush
a moment's pause, a breath, a fall into the unknown
and in the silence, a whispered truth is sown
